name: Ontario
description: Three very different lands: the Great Lakes–St. Lawrence Lowlands of the south (Toronto, Ottawa, London, Kingston), split by the Niagara Escarpment; the Canadian Shield of cottage-country lakes, rock and forest (Muskoka, Algonquin, Sudbury, Thunder Bay); and the roadless Hudson Bay Lowland in the far north.
